author: hank2 on Sketchfab
note: Authored Hindenburg airship by hank2, uniformly calibrated to 245 m overall length. Envelope, gondolas, fins and historically contextual tail markings are retained. The neutral envelope material is lightened for legibility; no independent axis scaling. Internal framework and gas bags are the artist’s illustration, not a structural survey. The swastikas on the tail fins of the original airship (and of the source model) are replaced here by plus signs; the red bands and white disks are kept.
basis_label: U.S. Commerce Department accident report: original dimensions

operations: Static-scene deduplication, flatten, join and weld
Simplify toward 45k triangles with maximum error 0.0008
Lighten only the neutral envelope material to linear RGB 0.65, roughness 0.58, metalness 0.08
Prune; quantize positions to 16 bits, normals to 12 bits and in-range UVs to 14 bits; no mesh compression
